count.description:
How many to keep around the player while they are in this biome. A
fraction is an extra one in that share of the country: 2.2 keeps two,
and a third in about one 128 m square in five.

morph.description:
Which of the creature's coats turn up here (see `MorphPick`): the glass
country's elk pale, the faerie wood's herons recoloured.

MorphPick.description:
Which coats a biome wants of a creature or plant it lists: one by name
("the pale hare here"), or weights that override the entry's own ("mostly
pale, some wild"). Left out, the entry's own weights stand.

PlaceVerb.description: How a biome places a plant or a feature (`placement.verb`).

Placement.description: A placement rule: which verb, and its parameters.

density.description: Plants per square metre where the placement allows them fully.

morph.description: Which of the plant's coats grow here (see `MorphPick`).

RealmCast.description: A realm's own species for one habitat (`RealmDef::habitats`).

creatures.description: Read by animal fill later (habitats plan H6); checked now.

ground.description:
Its look, in a world that asks for realm looks
(`WorldDef::realm_looks`): ground materials it turns into others, by
name (`{"meadow_grass": "pale_grass"}`), where its share of the
ground passes a noisy threshold, so changed ground comes in blobs.

habitats.description:
What each habitat holds in this realm, by habitat name: a dinosaur
marsh has giant horsetail and hadrosaurs. Drawn in by fill
(`WorldDef::fill`) wherever the realm comes through, so a world with
dinosaur ground gets the cast without a biome listing it.

mist.description: Ground mist where it is strong, 0 to 1, as a biome's `mist`.

notes.description: One sentence on what the entry is, for people and the catalogue.
